snippet.title: Chronoscript: The Endless End - Prologue Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming Fall 2026
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4018380/Chronoscript_The_Endless_End/?utm_source=shueishagames&utm_campaign=&utm_medium=youtube

Chronoscript: The Endless End is an upcoming exploration-based action-adventure game.

This trailer offers our first glimpse of the enigmatic character who is known only as the writer, and our protagonist, the editor, who can be seen navigating the newly revealed area: Ancient Egypt.

Bringing the world of Chronoscript: The Endless End to life are Mari Shimazaki on 3D character design, Yasunori Mitsuda and the PROCYON STUDIO team on music and sound effects, and Manami Kiyota as a guest composer!

■About Chronoscript: The Endless End
A thousand years of words… waiting for your final mark.

Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

■Prologue
The year is AD 2026.

With a long-running serial now behind him, an editor receives a curious new assignment.

He travels to a manor deep in the mountains where the client awaits, only to black out the instant a mosquito sucks his blood.

When he comes back to his senses, he finds himself within the pages of a story that writes itself beyond its end, a manuscript penned by the master of the manor, a writer who has lived for a millennium.
